title: Comparison of a Proj twist with any prescribed glued twist
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x₀,x₁] with its standard grading, d an integer, and C a chart-compatible isomorphism Proj S ≅ P¹_k [def-sc-p1-proj-chart-isomorphism]. Let L be an O-module on P¹_k with specified TwistData of degree d [def-sc-p1-standard]. Then Proj.twist S d [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] is isomorphic to tensorPullback(C.iso.hom)(L) [def-pc-module-pullback]. No choice or existence of C or L is asserted.

source.place: Definition 27.10.1 (1), Lemma 01M7 (2),(3); parent node chart and overlap proof steps

proof.text: On D₊(xᵢ), sections of the Proj twist are degree-d homogeneous fractions. Multiplication by xᵢ^(-d) gives the degree-zero ring and therefore xᵢ^d is a free generator on every subopen. For negative d, this power is interpreted in the localization where xᵢ is a unit.

By C.chart_eq, C identifies these affine charts and their ratio coordinates with the standard projective-line charts. The tensor-formula pullback transports each generator of L to a generator on D₊(xᵢ): inverse image along an isomorphism transports the local structure ring isomorphically and extension of scalars transports a free rank-one module to a free rank-one module. Define the local module isomorphism by sending xᵢ^d to this transported generator.

On the intersection, x₀^d=(x₀/x₁)^d x₁^d=t^(-d)x₁^d. The two transported generators obey the identical relation by TwistData.map_g₀. Restricting to any subopen of the intersection gives the same relation, so the local generator-preserving maps agree. Glue them to a global map by the sheaf property. Their local inverses agree too; glue the inverses. Both composites restrict to the identity on the two-member cover and so are identities by separation. This gives the required module isomorphism.

theorem nonempty_twist_iso_tensorPullback_of_twistData (k : Type v) [Field k]
    (d : ℤ) (C : ProjectiveLine.ProjChartIsomorphism k)
    (L : (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))).Modules)
    (T : ProjectiveLine.TwistData (Spec (.of k)) d L) :

      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback C.iso.hom).obj L)
